A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.8.33; 
father of: Eleazar (H0499K)
§ Phinehas = "mouth of brass"
1) son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron; his zealousness for the Lord averted a plague on Israel and gained him the promise of the Lord of an everlasting priesthood in his family
2) a priest and the son of the priest Eli
3) the father of a helper of Ezra

A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.41 
§ Pinon = "darkness"
one of the chiefs of Edom

tooth
Another spelling of pe.yah (פֵּיָה "two-edged" H6366)

§ Pison = "increase"
one of the four rivers used to describe the location of the garden of Eden

1) to trickle, pour
1a) (Piel) to trickle, drop down (water)
